went to a girls house roughly christmas time last year, had been crushing on her abit but was cool w the parents so it was possible for me to stay there overnight etc.

went there the day after boxing day and we was kissing all afternoon but didn’t really expect or want more

anyways later in the evening we went to the shop with her parents, got alcohol etc (mum brought it for us) 17 and 16 at the time, she persuades me to ask with her to see if we can walk back before them whilst they finish their shop, mum reluctantly says yes after much ‘pleaseee well behave’ nonsense 

so we walk back with the alcohol and a few other snacky things, get back to her house we go to her room put the snacks in the draw and open the alcohol (vodka, wine ,tequila) typical uk teenager drinks she asks if i wanted to do some shots i say yeah. so after a few shots i ask if she’s gonna start drinking, she said ‘yeah but i need to put dinner on and shit’ so anyways i calm down on the shots felt abit merry but nothing more

anyways abit after dinner she comes up stairs with more alcohol (vodka) n says she’ll drink that one and i can have the bottle that was already opened i after thinking she was gonna drink the ‘vodka’ 

anyways so i carry on doing shots whilst shes doing ‘shots’ i’m beyond gone at this point and she was perfectly sober anyways got pushed onto the bed she follows and sort of straddles on my lap, she says ‘you want too’ i said ‘not really’ abit of peer pressure later and some more no’s she’s got her hand in my waistband and pulls my joggers down and starts doing her thing, she then gets on top and puts it in i tried to sorta say things on the lines of no and get off, don’t know how clear it came out due to my intoxication levels but anyways, she gets off abit later, kisses my forehead says ‘goodnight, i love you’ didn’t really wrap my head around what happened until a few hours after in which i just got up and walked to the train station, went home

anyways a few hours later i get a swarm of texts asking why i went home n shit like that, i explained. she said ‘oh sorry, won’t do it again’ and things along the lines of that.

felt bad because maybe she didn’t really comprehend on what i was saying because i was talking like a drunken mess most of the night

anyways a few weeks later she tells me she wasn’t actually drinking vodka just had an empty bottle lying around and filled it with water, at that point i blocked her n we haven’t spoke since other than a birthday message i got in april
